<html lang="en" style="--factsbot: 15px; --sinset: 90px; --sfont: 1.25; --logoh: 46.1px; --sheady: -9.0px; --sheadx: 86.5px; --barbg: rgba(255,255,255,0.150); --barbgh: rgba(255,255,255,0.270); --barbd: rgba(255,255,255,0.900); --bartx: rgba(255,255,255,0.950); --barfx: blur(20px) saturate(135%) brightness(1.48); --bartop: 562.1px;"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>VoiceMem — memory graph</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#f2f4f8;
    --dim:#7d8496;
    --line:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
    --blue:#4aa8f0;
    --rose:#ff3d8b;
    --violet:#a583ff;
    --mint:#58e08d;
    --pink:#ff5fa2;
    --amber:#ff9a3c;
    --leaf:#4ade80;
    --brass:#e0a94a;
    /* these twelve are written by the UI block in JS */
    --sinset:112px;
    --sfont:1;
    --sheady:-6px;
    --sheadx:45px;
    --logoh:36px;
    --factsbot:190px;
    --bartop:570px;
    --barbg:rgba(255,255,255,.15);--barbgh:rgba(255,255,255,.27);
    --barbd:rgba(255,255,255,.9);--bartx:rgba(255,255,255,.95);
    --barfx:blur(20px) saturate(135%) brightness(1.48);
    /* one unit drives all the legend type. It is anchored to the small-screen
       size (22px at 1600px wide) and grows with the viewport from there, but
       at a gentler slope than the window — so 2K reads large without shouting.
       Half fixed, half fluid: 1600 -> 22px, 2560 -> 28.6px, 3840 -> 37.4px. */
    --sunit:max(15px, 11px + 0.6875vw);
    --mono:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;
    --serif:"Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Palatino,Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{height:auto;scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{
    margin:0;background:#000;color:var(--ink);
    font-family:var(--mono);
    overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  /* one continuous document. Page one is a normal 100vh block that scrolls
     away like anything else; #veil darkens it to black on the way out so the
     hand-off into page two is a dissolve, not a cut. */
  #shell{
    position:relative;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    padding:clamp(14px,2.2vh,26px) clamp(14px,3vw,40px) var(--factsbot);
  }
  #veil{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:40;background:#000;
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;will-change:opacity;
  }

  /* ---------- top bar ---------- */
  .topbar{
    flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;z-index:8;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;
    /* bleed past the shell's padding so the strip reaches both window edges */
    margin:calc(-1*clamp(14px,2.2vh,26px)) calc(-1*clamp(14px,3vw,40px)) 0;
    padding:clamp(7px,1.1vh,14px) clamp(14px,3vw,40px);
    background:rgba(17,20,30,.66);
    backdrop-filter:blur(9px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(9px);
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.085);
    box-shadow:0 14px 38px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.95);
  }
  .logos{display:flex;align-items:center}
  /* one merged strip — height drives it, width follows the file's own ratio */
  .logos img{height:var(--logoh);width:auto;min-height:18px;display:block;
             object-fit:contain}
  .logos img[data-missing]{display:none}
  .topnav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(16px,2vw,34px)}
  .tlink{
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:clamp(10.5px,.85vw,13px);
    letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:#cfd6e4;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;
    border:0;background:none;padding:2px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);
    transition:color .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;
  }
  .tlink:hover{color:#fff;border-bottom-color:#fff}
  /* language picker — opens on hover, and on keyboard focus */
  .lang{position:relative;cursor:pointer;outline:none}
  .lmenu{
    position:absolute;top:100%;right:0;padding-top:13px;   /* the hover bridge */
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(-5px);
    transition:opacity .24s ease,transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  }
  .lang:hover .lmenu,.lang:focus-within .lmenu{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}
  .lpanel{
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:132px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;
    background:rgba(9,11,17,.78);
    backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
    box-shadow:0 22px 46px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.95);
  }
  .lpanel a{
    padding:9px 15px;color:#c3cbdb;text-decoration:none;border:0;
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:clamp(10px,.8vw,12px);letter-spacing:.08em;
    text-transform:none;white-space:nowrap;
    transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease;
  }
  .lpanel a + a{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
  .lpanel a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:#fff}
  .cta{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(9px,.8vw,14px);
    background:#c9b6f7;color:#161226;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:clamp(10.5px,.85vw,13px);letter-spacing:.02em;
    border-radius:11px;padding:5px 5px 5px clamp(12px,1.1vw,18px);
    box-shadow:0 6px 20px -8px rgba(160,130,255,.7);
    transition:background .3s ease,transform .3s ease;
  }
  .cta:hover{background:#d9caff;transform:translateY(-1px)}
  .cta .ar{
    width:clamp(20px,1.85vw,26px);height:clamp(20px,1.85vw,26px);flex:0 0 auto;
    border-radius:50%;background:#111017;color:#fff;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-size:clamp(10px,.8vw,13px);line-height:1;
  }

  /* ---------- masthead ---------- */
  header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(14px,2vw,26px);flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;z-index:4;
         margin-top:clamp(14px,2.8vh,36px)}
  header .rule{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--line) 22%,var(--line) 78%,transparent)}
  /* the two rules sit level with the CENTRE of the title + strapline block,
     which falls out of align-items:center on the header itself */
  .mast{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:clamp(5px,.9vh,11px)}
  .tag{
    margin:0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:clamp(9.5px,.82vw,13px);
    letter-spacing:.32em;text-indent:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:#7f8899;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  header h1{
    margin:0;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(25px,3.3vw,44px);
    letter-spacing:.40em;text-indent:.40em;white-space:nowrap;
    color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(180,205,255,.42);
  }

  /* ---------- stage ---------- */
  #shell main{flex:1 1 auto;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:0}
  #stage{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%}
  #brain{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;
    object-fit:fill;mix-blend-mode:screen;
    filter:brightness(.92) contrast(1.06);
    opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.4s ease .1s;
    pointer-events:none;user-select:none;
  }
  #brain.in{opacity:1}
  /* one canvas covering page one draws the graph, the beams and the platter */
  #fx{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
  /* one stacking context: cortex 0 < canvas 2 < legends 3 < chrome 4 < bar 6 < card 7 */

  /* ---------- hemisphere legends ---------- */
  .side{
    position:absolute;top:46%;transform:translateY(-50%);
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(22px,3.3vh,36px);z-index:3;
    pointer-events:auto;
  }
  .side.l{left:var(--sinset);align-items:flex-start}
  .side.r{right:var(--sinset);align-items:flex-end}
  .side h2{
    margin:0 0 6px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;
    font-size:calc(var(--sunit)*var(--sfont));letter-spacing:.01em;color:#e8ecf5;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .side.l h2{transform:translateY(var(--sheady))}
  .side.r h2{transform:translate(var(--sheadx),var(--sheady))}
  .side.l h2 em{font-style:italic;color:#7fb2e8}
  .side.r h2 em{font-style:italic;color:#e879a8}
  .key{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;cursor:default;
    font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:calc(var(--sunit)*.75*var(--sfont));
    color:var(--dim);transition:color .35s ease,opacity .35s ease;padding:4px 0;
  }
  .side.r .key{flex-direction:row-reverse}
  .key:hover{color:#fff}
  .key .g{width:calc(var(--sunit)*.59*var(--sfont));height:calc(var(--sunit)*.59*var(--sfont));
          flex:0 0 calc(var(--sunit)*.59*var(--sfont));opacity:.85;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
  .key .g svg{width:100%;height:100%}
  .key:hover .g{transform:scale(1.35)}
  .key .g svg{display:block;overflow:visible}

  /* ---------- frosted action bar ---------- */
  /* the bar is only a row now — each control is its own frosted pill */
  .glass{
    position:absolute;left:50%;top:var(--bartop);transform:translateX(-50%);
    display:flex;gap:clamp(10px,1.1vw,18px);z-index:6;
  }
  .glass > *{
    appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;
    border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;
    border:1px solid var(--barbd);
    background:var(--barbg);
    backdrop-filter:var(--barfx);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--barfx);
    box-shadow:
      0 18px 50px -22px rgba(0,0,0,.9),
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5),
      inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16),
      0 0 34px -10px rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:clamp(10.5px,.92vw,13px);
    letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--bartx);text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
    text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;
    padding:12px clamp(16px,1.8vw,28px);
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;white-space:nowrap;
    transition:background .3s ease,color .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;
  }
  .glass > *:hover{background:var(--barbgh);border-color:#fff;color:#fff}
  .glass .d{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;opacity:.6;box-shadow:0 0 9px currentColor}
  .glass .d.b{background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 9px var(--blue)}
  .glass .d.p{background:var(--pink);box-shadow:0 0 9px var(--pink)}
  .glass .d.g{background:var(--leaf);box-shadow:0 0 9px var(--leaf)}
  /* 「Try it now」是唯一通往线上 demo 的入口，放在三个胶囊下面单独一行——但**不**做
     成第四个胶囊：四个一样重的按钮谁都不突出，而且横过整排的金色块太糙。退成一行
     小字加箭头，反倒因为是全场唯一有颜色的一行而更抓眼。 */
  .glass{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;row-gap:clamp(7px,.7vw,11px)}
  #btn-try{
    flex:0 0 100%;justify-content:center;gap:7px;
    /* .glass > * 那套胶囊样式在这儿全部退掉 */
    padding:2px 0;border:none;border-radius:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;
    backdrop-filter:none;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;
    font-size:clamp(9.5px,.8vw,11.5px);letter-spacing:.24em;
    color:#ffc44a;opacity:.88;transition:opacity .25s ease,color .25s ease;
  }
  #btn-try::after{content:"→";letter-spacing:0;opacity:.8}
  #btn-try:hover{background:none;border:none;color:#ffd884;opacity:1}
  #btn-try .d{width:4px;height:4px;opacity:.9}
  /* demo 跑在一台自托管的机器上，它关着的时候别把访客送去一个打不开的链接。 */
  #btn-try.down{color:var(--bartx);opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}
  #btn-try.down::after{content:""}
  #btn-try.down .d{background:#8b90a0;box-shadow:none}
  .glass .d.y{background:#ffc44a;box-shadow:0 0 9px #ffc44a}
  /* ---------- memory card ---------- */
  #card{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:252px;z-index:7;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.82);
    background:rgba(4,5,8,.82);
    backdrop-filter:blur(9px) saturate(120%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(9px) saturate(120%);
    padding:11px 12px 10px;
    opacity:0;transform:translate3d(-999px,-999px,0);
    transition:opacity .22s ease;
    will-change:transform,opacity;pointer-events:none;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.9),0 18px 50px -18px rgba(0,0,0,1);
  }
  #card.on{opacity:1}
  #card .eb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-bottom:9px}
  #card .sw{width:7px;height:7px;border:1.4px solid #fff;flex:0 0 7px}
  #card .kd{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.24em;color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase}
  #card .id{margin-left:auto;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#6c7382}
  /* the description sits on top, the memory indices under it */
  #card .dsc{
    font-family:var(--serif);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;
    color:#e4eaf5;margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  #card .mix{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-bottom:10px}
  #card .mix i{
    font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;
    color:#180d02;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:2px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe6a8,#f5ac3a);
    box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,175,60,.62),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  }
  #card .mix i.n{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffd0e6,#ff74b0);color:#2a0716;
                 box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,95,162,.6),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
  #card .ft{
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;
    color:#5d6472;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding-top:7px;
  }

  /* ---------- footer ---------- */
  footer{flex:0 0 auto;margin-top:8px;position:relative;z-index:4}
  .ticks{
    height:9px;margin-top:11px;
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line) 0 1px,transparent 1px 11px);
    -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent);
    mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent);
    opacity:.75;
  }
  /* stacked: the claim on top, the evidence under it */
  .facts{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;
         gap:clamp(16px,2.9vw,54px);flex-wrap:wrap}
  .facts > span{
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;
    text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;
    /* the legibility comes from a tight, even halo on the glyphs themselves —
       no panel, no pool, nothing that can occlude the drum behind them */
    text-shadow:0 0 2px #000, 0 0 4px #000, 0 0 7px rgba(0,0,0,.92), 0 1px 2px #000;
  }
  .facts .t{
    font-style:normal;font-size:clamp(12px,1.05vw,16.5px);
    color:#e8edf6;letter-spacing:.06em;
  }
  .facts b{font-weight:400;color:#fff}
  .facts .ck{margin-right:2px}
  .facts em{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:#9fb6d8;
            font-size:clamp(10.5px,.92vw,14.5px);letter-spacing:.01em}
  .facts .ck{color:#6fe0a0}

  .hint{
    position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:1.2%;transform:translateX(-50%);
    font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#4d545f;z-index:4;
    animation:fade 6s ease 3.4s forwards;pointer-events:none;
  }
  @keyframes fade{to{opacity:0}}

  /* ---------- the scroll cue at the foot of page one ---------- */
  #cue{
    position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:14px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:9;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.28em;
    color:rgba(210,218,232,.55);text-transform:uppercase;pointer-events:none;
    text-shadow:0 0 8px #000,0 1px 3px #000;
  }
  #cue i{display:block;width:1px;height:22px;
         background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent);
         animation:cuedrop 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
  @keyframes cuedrop{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.25}50%{transform:translateY(7px);opacity:.9}}

  @media (max-width:1000px){
    .side{display:none}
    .topnav{gap:14px}
    header h1{letter-spacing:.28em;text-indent:.28em}
    #card{width:210px}
    .glass{gap:8px}
    .glass > *{padding:11px 15px;letter-spacing:.12em}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    .hint{animation:none}
  }
</style>
















<style id="voicemem-revision-v7-hero">
/* Page one: the scroll cue and the hover hint were both absolutely
   positioned into the same strip as the footer facts, so all three
   collided at the foot of the screen. Give the footer room, and move
   the hint up under the action pills where it actually belongs. */
#shell{padding-bottom:calc(var(--factsbot) + 56px)!important}
#cue{bottom:15px!important;z-index:11!important}
.hint{bottom:8px!important;top:auto!important;z-index:5!important}
/* wordmark fallback when ./images/image_all.webp is not next to the file */
.logos a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none}
.logo-fb{display:none}
.logos img[data-missing] + .logo-fb{
  display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.20em;
  text-transform:none;color:#eef2f9;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(150,185,255,.45);
}
/* the frosted pills sit over the densest part of the graph — lift them off it */
.glass > *{box-shadow:0 10px 30px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
</style>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style id="voicemem-chapters">
/* =====================================================================
   VoiceMem — chapters. Page one is untouched; everything from the demo
   down runs on one shared system: a big chapter word, a vertical rule,
   one sentence. No 9px footnotes anywhere.
   ===================================================================== */
:root{
  --sans:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --code:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;
  --ink-1:#0e1116; --ink-2:#3c434e; --ink-3:#6d7683;
  --edge:#dfe4ea;
  --accent:#3f74b6;
  --violet:#c4a7ff; --violet-2:#a97cf5;
}
#page2,#page3,#framework,#benchmarking{
  position:relative;z-index:20;font-family:var(--sans);color:var(--ink-1);
  box-sizing:border-box;
}
#page2 *,#page3 *,#framework *,#benchmarking *{box-sizing:border-box}

/* ---------- the shared chapter header ---------- */
.ch{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1px minmax(0,auto);
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;column-gap:clamp(20px,2.2vw,34px);
  width:min(1180px,92vw);margin:0 auto;padding:0;
}
.ch-word{
  margin:0;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,86px);line-height:.94;letter-spacing:.004em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-1);white-space:nowrap;text-align:right;
}
.ch-bar{
  display:block;width:1px;height:clamp(54px,5.4vw,84px);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(14,17,22,.30) 16%,rgba(14,17,22,.30) 84%,transparent);
}
.ch-say{
  margin:0;max-width:30ch;text-wrap:balance;
  font-size:clamp(16px,1.42vw,24px);line-height:1.32;font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:-.012em;color:var(--accent);
}
.ch--dark .ch-word{color:#fff}
.ch--dark .ch-bar{background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.34) 16%,rgba(255,255,255,.34) 84%,transparent)}
.ch--dark .ch-say{color:var(--violet)}

/* =====================================================================
   CHAPTER 01 — DEMO
   ===================================================================== */
#page2{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  gap:clamp(26px,3.4vh,44px);
  padding:clamp(300px,34vh,400px) 22px clamp(64px,8vh,96px);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,
    #000 0,#020304 32px,#090b0f 72px,#171b21 116px,#2e343d 160px,
    #565d69 204px,#878f9b 240px,#b8bec7 268px,#dfe3e8 292px,#f7f8fa 312px,#fff 336px,
    #fff 100%);
}
#page2 .d-frame{
  position:relative;width:min(1120px,60vw);padding:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 30px 80px -50px rgba(20,30,50,.45);
}
#page2 .d-frame iframe,#page2 .d-frame video{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border:0;border-radius:11px;background:#0b0c0f;object-fit:cover}
.d-link{
  font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;

<!-- ================= PAGE FOUR — FRAMEWORK ================= -->
<section id="framework">
  <header class="ch">
    <h2 class="ch-word" data-i18n="intro.title">Introduction</h2>
    <span class="ch-bar" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <p class="ch-say" data-i18n="intro.say">Two brains. One voice. Nothing to wait for.</p>
  </header>
  <div class="in-wrap">
    <article class="in-block">
      <h3 class="in-sub" data-i18n="intro.archTitle">Streaming dual-brain architecture</h3>
      <figure class="in-fig"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1234" height="789" src="./images/fig-architecture.webp" alt="VoiceMem architecture"></figure>
      <p class="in-say" data-i18n="intro.archBody">The left brain organizes factual memory through schemas and entities, while the right brain models personality and emotion with independent and cross-entity nodes. The entire pipeline is streaming: while the user is still speaking, audio is segmented, transcribed, extracted, and written into the graph. At query time, VoiceMem routes first, ranks second, and injects only the Top-K memories into context.</p>
    </article>

    <article class="in-block">
      <h3 class="in-sub" data-i18n="intro.opdTitle">Datasets and voice-model family built with OPD</h3>
      <figure class="in-fig"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1192" height="585" src="./images/fig-opd.webp" alt="VoiceMem training and data flow"></figure>
      <p class="in-say" data-i18n="intro.opdBody">ChatMem-400K is produced by a three-stage pipeline of memory-world construction, SLM-validated online on-policy distillation, and human refinement; the same pipeline also produces the ChatMem-Bench evaluation set. After OPD distillation, Qwen2.5-Omni, Qwen3-Omni, and Step-Audio2-Mini learn to proactively invoke memory without sacrificing their original speech capabilities.</p>

   Half the memories are missing at load, and the `projects` schema does

   burst; queries two through five fill in everything that is left. After

const PROJ = [];

PROJ.forEach(i=>{ PROJSET[i] = 1; });
const WAVES = [[],[],[],[],[]];
(function seed(){
  // both hemispheres start half-populated; the projects schema does not
  // exist yet at all. Every hidden memory arrives later, sprouted.
  const poolL = [], poolR = [];
  for(const n of N){
    if(n.k==='user'){ n.sh = 1; continue; }
    if(PROJSET[n.id]){ n.sh = 0; continue; }
    if(n.k==='label'){ n.sh = 1; continue; }
    (n.side==='R' ? poolR : poolL).push(n.id);
  }
  const hidden = [];
  for(const pool of [poolL, poolR]){
    shuf(pool);
    const keep = Math.round(pool.length*UI.seedShare);
    pool.forEach((id,i)=>{ N[id].sh = i < keep ? 1 : 0; if(i >= keep) hidden.push(id); });
  }
  shuf(hidden);
  const cut = Math.ceil(hidden.length*UI.firstWaveShare);
  WAVES[0] = PROJ.slice().concat(hidden.slice(0, cut));
  const rest = hidden.slice(cut);
  for(let i=0;i<rest.length;i++) WAVES[1 + (i % (UI.fullAt-1))].push(rest[i]);
})();

/* the sprout — white filaments push out of the memories that already exist
   and a new node lands on the end of each one */
const GROW = { t:0, items:[], live:false, span:0 };
function growWave(ids){
  const known = {}, list = [];
  for(const n of N) if(n.sh) known[n.id] = 1;
  // schemas first, so their children can hang off them
  ids.slice().sort((a,b)=> (N[a].k==='label'?0:1) - (N[b].k==='label'?0:1))
     .forEach((id,i)=>{
    const n = N[id];
    let pa = null;
    for(const b of NB[id]) if(known[b]){ pa = b; break; }
    if(pa == null){
      let bd = Infinity;
      for(const k in known){
        const q = N[k|0], d = (q.sx-n.sx)*(q.sx-n.sx) + (q.sy-n.sy)*(q.sy-n.sy);
        if(d < bd){ bd = d; pa = q.id; }
      }
    }
    if(pa == null) pa = USER >= 0 ? USER : 0;
    known[id] = 1;
    list.push({ id, pa, t0: i*UI.growStagger, dur: UI.growReach, u:0, born:false });
  });
  GROW.items = list; GROW.t = 0; GROW.live = list.length > 0;
  GROW.span = list.length ? list[list.length-1].t0 + UI.growReach + 0.8 : 0;
  return GROW.span;
}

  if(QN >= UI.fullAt) return 0;

}

function radial(col, R, a0){
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = R*2;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  const rg = g.createRadialGradient(R,R,0,R,R,R);
  rg.addColorStop(0,   hexa(col,a0));
  rg.addColorStop(.28, hexa(col,a0*0.36));
  rg.addColorStop(.62, hexa(col,a0*0.09));
  rg.addColorStop(1,   hexa(col,0));
  g.fillStyle = rg; g.fillRect(0,0,R*2,R*2);
  return c;
}
function buildGlow(){
  for(const k in PAL){
    if(k==='label') continue;
    GLOW[k] = radial(PAL[k], Math.max(18, Math.round((k==='user'? 150 : 56)*S)), .55);
  }
  BRASSGLOW = radial('#ffc154', 46, .85);
  WHITEGLOW = radial('#dfefff', 40, .85);
}
function hexa(h,a){
  const n = parseInt(h.slice(1),16);
  return 'rgba('+(n>>16)+','+(n>>8&255)+','+(n&255)+','+a+')';
}

const DISC = { tiles:[], map:null, hot:[], live:[], walls:[], hits:[], rowsIdx:[],
               byNum:null, cw:1, rowH:1, mat:null, litFlag:false,
               cx:0, cy:0, RX:1, RY:1, hz:0, top:0, ramp:1, on:0, wallH:0,
               env:0, rest:0.055 };
function pad3(v){ return String(v).padStart(3,'0'); }
function buildDisc(band){
  const apex  = H*UI.discY;
  const wallH = DISC.wallH = Math.max(8, H*UI.discWall);
  DISC.top  = apex - band*0.57;
  DISC.ramp = Math.max(1, band*0.95);
  if(band < 4){
    DISC.tiles = []; DISC.hot = []; DISC.walls = []; DISC.live.length = 0;
    DISC.hits.length = 0; DISC.rowsIdx = [];
    DISC.map = new Map(); DISC.byNum = new Map(); DISC.mat = null; DISC.env = 0; DISC.on = 0;
    if(DISC.litFlag){ DISC.litFlag = false; document.body.classList.remove('lit'); }
    return;
  }
  const maskTop = Math.max(0, DISC.top - DISC.ramp);
  const dcx = DISC.cx = CX;
  const RX  = DISC.RX = W*UI.discWidth;
  const RY  = DISC.RY = Math.max(70, RX*UI.discCurve);
  const dcy2 = DISC.cy = apex - RY;
  const hz  = DISC.hz = dcy2;
  const dcy = dcy2;
  const span = Math.max(1, (dcy+RY) - hz);
  const rowH = Math.max(10, band*0.088);
  const dep  = y => 0.24 + 0.76*Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (y-hz)/span));
  const arcY = x => { const u=(x-dcx)/RX; return dcy + RY*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-u*u)); };

  const rows = [];
  let yb = dcy + RY;
  for(let g=0; g<220; g++){
    const s = dep(yb), h = rowH*s;
    const yt = yb - h;
    if(yt < maskTop) break;
    rows.push({ y:yt, h, s });
    yb = yt;
  }

  const cw = rowH*2;
  const tiles = [], map = new Map();
  for(let ri=0; ri<rows.length; ri++){
    const R = rows[ri], w = cw*R.s, cy = R.y + R.h/2;
    const uy = (cy-dcy)/RY;
    if(uy*uy >= 1) continue;
    const half = RX*Math.sqrt(1-uy*uy);
    const lim  = Math.min(half, W/2 + w*2 + Math.abs(dcx-W/2));
    const m    = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (cy-maskTop)/DISC.ramp));
    const jMax = Math.ceil(lim/w);
    for(let j=-jMax; j<=jMax; j++){
      const x = dcx + j*w - w/2;
      if(x+w < -w || x > W+w) continue;
      if(Math.abs(dcx + j*w - dcx) > half) continue;
      const num = (Math.abs(j)*37 + ri*113 + 7) % 1000;
      const t = { x, y:R.y, w:Math.max(1.5,w-1), h:Math.max(1.2,R.h-1),
                  cx:x+w/2, cy, row:ri, col:j, s:R.s,
                  e:0, a:0, on:false, m:m*m*m, tone:0.42+Math.random()*0.58,
                  d:Math.min(1, Math.max(0,(cy-maskTop)/Math.max(1,H-maskTop))),
                  num, sn:'M：'+pad3(num) };
      map.set(ri*8192 + (j+4096), tiles.length);
      tiles.push(t);
    }
  }
  const walls = [];
  {
    const jw = Math.ceil((RX + Math.abs(dcx-W/2) + cw)/cw);
    for(let j=-jw; j<=jw; j++){
      const xL = dcx + j*cw - cw/2, xR = xL + cw;
      if(xR < -cw || xL > W+cw) continue;
      const uL = (xL-dcx)/RX, uR = (xR-dcx)/RX;
      if(Math.abs(uL) >= 1 && Math.abs(uR) >= 1) continue;
      const cxw = (xL+xR)/2;
      const hf = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1-Math.pow((cxw-dcx)/RX, 2)));
      if(hf < 0.045) continue;
      walls.push({ xL:Math.max(xL, dcx-RX), xR:Math.min(xR, dcx+RX),
                   yL:arcY(Math.max(xL, dcx-RX)), yR:arcY(Math.min(xR, dcx+RX)),
                   cx:cxw, hf, tone:0.45+Math.random()*0.55,
                   sn:'M：'+pad3((Math.abs(j)*53 + 311) % 1000) });
    }
  }
  DISC.walls = walls;

  DISC.tiles = tiles; DISC.map = map; DISC.live.length = 0;
  DISC.hits.length = 0; DISC.cw = cw; DISC.rowH = rowH;
  const rowsIdx = [];
  tiles.forEach((t,i)=>{ (rowsIdx[t.row] = rowsIdx[t.row] || []).push(i); });
  DISC.rowsIdx = rowsIdx;
  DISC.hot = tiles.map((t,i)=>t.m>0.45?i:-1).filter(i=>i>=0);
  if(!DISC.hot.length) DISC.hot = tiles.map((t,i)=>i);
  const byNum = new Map();
  tiles.forEach((t,i)=>{ if(t.m < 0.35) return; const a = byNum.get(t.num); if(a) a.push(i); else byNum.set(t.num,[i]); });
  DISC.byNum = byNum;

  const bt = maskTop, bh = Math.max(1, H-maskTop);
  const bc = document.createElement('canvas');
  bc.width = Math.max(1,Math.round(W*DPR)); bc.height = Math.max(1,Math.round(bh*DPR));
  const g = bc.getContext('2d');
  g.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  g.translate(0,-bt);
  g.textAlign='center'; g.textBaseline='middle';
  let lastF = '';
  for(const t of tiles){
    const dd = t.d*t.d*(3-2*t.d);
    const jit  = (t.tone-0.70)*0.17;
    const base = 0.20 + 0.52*dd + jit;
    const top  = base + 0.15, bot = base - 0.15;
    const lg = g.createLinearGradient(0, t.y, 0, t.y+t.h);
    lg.addColorStop(0,    bronze(top));
    lg.addColorStop(0.55, bronze(base-0.03));
    lg.addColorStop(1,    bronze(bot));
    g.fillStyle = lg;
    g.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h);
    g.fillStyle = bronze(top+0.20);
    g.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.w, 1);
    g.fillRect(t.x, t.y, 1, t.h);
    g.fillStyle = bronze(bot-0.16);
    g.fillRect(t.x, t.y+t.h-1, t.w, 1);
    g.fillRect(t.x+t.w-1, t.y, 1, t.h);
    // the memory index is the point of the whole drum, so it is struck bright:
    // a hard black shadow under a hot filament-yellow face, with a halo
    if(t.h >= 7){
      const fs = Math.min(t.h*0.62, t.w*0.30);
      const ff = fs.toFixed(1)+'px '+MONOF;
      if(ff !== lastF){ lastF = ff; g.font = ff; }
      g.shadowBlur = 0; g.shadowColor = 'transparent';
      g.fillStyle = '#000';
      g.fillText(t.sn, t.cx, t.cy+0.2);
    }
  }
  for(const v of walls){
    const l = 0.16 + 0.50*v.hf*v.hf + (v.tone-0.70)*0.13;
    const top = l + 0.20, bot = l - 0.30;
    const wg = g.createLinearGradient(0, v.yL, 0, v.yL+wallH);
    wg.addColorStop(0,   bronze(top));
    wg.addColorStop(0.32,bronze(l));
    wg.addColorStop(1,   bronze(bot));
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(v.xL, v.yL); g.lineTo(v.xR, v.yR);
    g.lineTo(v.xR, v.yR+wallH); g.lineTo(v.xL, v.yL+wallH); g.closePath();
    g.fillStyle = wg; g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle = bronze(bot-0.10); g.lineWidth = 1;
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(v.xR-.5, v.yR); g.lineTo(v.xR-.5, v.yR+wallH); g.stroke();
    if(wallH >= 18 && v.hf > 0.14){
      const fs = Math.min(wallH*0.30, cw*0.30);
      g.font = fs.toFixed(1)+'px '+MONOF;
      const my = (v.yL+v.yR)/2 + wallH*0.52;
      g.shadowBlur = 0; g.shadowColor = 'transparent';
      g.fillStyle = '#000'; g.fillText(v.sn, v.cx, my+0.2);
    }
    lastF = '';
  }
  g.beginPath();
  g.ellipse(dcx, dcy, RX, RY, 0, 0.06, Math.PI-0.06);
  g.strokeStyle = bronze(0.92); g.lineWidth = Math.max(3, wallH*0.11); g.stroke();
  g.strokeStyle = bronze(0.40); g.lineWidth = 1;
  g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(dcx, dcy, RX, RY, 0, 0.06, Math.PI-0.06); g.stroke();
  g.save(); g.translate(0, wallH);
  g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(dcx, dcy, RX, RY, 0, 0.06, Math.PI-0.06);
  g.strokeStyle = bronze(0.10); g.lineWidth = Math.max(2, wallH*0.06); g.stroke();
  g.restore();

  if(!NOISE) NOISE = makeNoise();
  g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop';
  g.fillStyle = g.createPattern(NOISE,'repeat');
  g.fillRect(0, bt, W, bh);
  g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  g.beginPath();
  g.ellipse(dcx, dcy, RX, RY, 0, 0.12, Math.PI-0.12);
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(214,168,96,.5)'; g.lineWidth = 1.4; g.stroke();
  g.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
  const mg = g.createLinearGradient(0, maskTop, 0, DISC.top);
  mg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); mg.addColorStop(0.45,'rgba(0,0,0,.22)');
  mg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
  g.fillStyle = mg; g.fillRect(0, bt, W, bh);
  g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  DISC.mat = bc; DISC.baseTop = bt; DISC.baseH = bh;
}
function bronze(l){
  l = l < 0 ? 0 : l > 1 ? 1 : l;
  const r = 30 + 205*Math.pow(l,0.92);
  const gr = 21 + 156*Math.pow(l,1.08);
  const b = 12 +  92*Math.pow(l,1.42);
  return 'rgb('+(r|0)+','+(gr|0)+','+(b|0)+')';
}
let NOISE = null;
function makeNoise(){
  const n = 110, c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = n;
  const g = c.getContext('2d'), im = g.createImageData(n,n), d = im.data;
  for(let i=0;i<n*n;i++){
    const v = Math.random();
    const l = v < 0.52 ? 0 : 255;
    d[i*4] = d[i*4+1] = d[i*4+2] = l;
    d[i*4+3] = Math.random() < 0.55 ? 0 : Math.random()*54;
  }
  g.putImageData(im,0,0);
  return c;
}
function drawDisc(dt){
  if(!DISC.mat) return;
  const want = SR.st==='ret' ? 1
    : ((SR.st==='dump' && !SR.fading && SR.drops.length)
        ? Math.min(1, SR.arrived/Math.max(1, SR.drops.length*0.55)) : 0);
  DISC.env += (want - DISC.env) *
              (want > DISC.env ? 1-Math.exp(-dt*3.6) : 1-Math.exp(-dt*5.0));
  const on = DISC.on = DISC.env;
  const lit = on > .10;
  if(lit !== DISC.litFlag){ DISC.litFlag = lit; document.body.classList.toggle('lit', lit); }

  ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, DISC.rest + on*0.30);
  ctx.drawImage(DISC.mat, 0, DISC.baseTop, W, DISC.baseH);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  if(on > .01){
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, DISC.top-30, 0, DISC.top+70);
    lg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(206,150,66,0)');
    lg.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(206,150,66,'+(0.05*on).toFixed(3)+')');
    lg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(206,150,66,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = lg; ctx.fillRect(0, DISC.top-30, W, 100);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  }

  const T = DISC.tiles, live = DISC.live;
  const RISE = 1 - Math.exp(-dt*3.4);

  const hits = DISC.hits;
  if(hits.length && BRASSGLOW){
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    for(let i=hits.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const q = hits[i];
      q.e += (q.c - q.e)*RISE;
      q.c -= dt*q.c*0.06;
      const a = q.e*DISC.env*q.m;
      if(a > .008){
        ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, a*0.32);
        ctx.drawImage(BRASSGLOW, q.x-q.rx, q.y-q.ry, q.rx*2, q.ry*2);
      }
      if((q.e < .006 && q.c < .004) || DISC.env < .012) hits.splice(i,1);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  }
  if(!live.length) return;
  const MD = DISC.baseTop;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  for(let i=live.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const t = T[live[i]];
    const e = t.e * DISC.env;
    if(e > .012){
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, e*0.72);
      ctx.drawImage(DISC.mat, t.x*DPR, (t.y-MD)*DPR, t.w*DPR, t.h*DPR,
                              t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h);
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, e*0.44);
      ctx.drawImage(DISC.mat, t.x*DPR, (t.y-MD)*DPR, t.w*DPR, t.h*DPR,
                              t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,176,78,'+(0.18*e).toFixed(3)+')';
      ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h);
      if(e > .34){
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,226,168,'+(0.26*e).toFixed(3)+')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(t.x+.5, t.y+.5, t.w-1, t.h-1);
      }
      // struck white-hot once the block is properly lit — the index is the
      // thing the viewer is meant to read
      if(e > .30 && t.h >= 7){
        const fs = Math.min(t.h*0.62, t.w*0.30);
        ctx.font = fs.toFixed(1)+'px '+MONOF;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,247,220,'+Math.min(1,(e-0.24)*1.7).toFixed(3)+')';
        ctx.fillText(t.sn, t.cx, t.cy+0.4);
      }
    }
    t.e = t.e + (t.a - t.e)*RISE;
    t.a -= dt*t.a*0.06;
    if((t.e < .006 && t.a < .004) || DISC.env < .012){
      t.e = 0; t.a = 0; t.on = false; live.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
}
function lightTile(i, v){
  const T = DISC.tiles; if(!T.length) return;
  i = ((i % T.length)+T.length) % T.length;
  const t0 = T[i];
  const Rx = DISC.cw*1.45, Ry = DISC.rowH*2.1;
  for(let dr=-5; dr<=5; dr++){
    const row = DISC.rowsIdx[t0.row+dr];
    if(!row) continue;
    for(let k=0;k<row.length;k++){
      const j = row[k], o = T[j];
      const ux = (o.cx-t0.cx)/Rx; if(ux < -1 || ux > 1) continue;
      const uy = (o.cy-t0.cy)/Ry;
      const d2 = ux*ux + uy*uy;
      if(d2 >= 1) continue;
      const w = 1-Math.sqrt(d2);
      const f = w*w*(3-2*w);
      o.a = Math.min(1.35, o.a + v*f*(0.30+0.70*o.m));
      if(!o.on){ o.on = true; DISC.live.push(j); }
    }
  }
  DISC.hits.push({ x:t0.cx, y:t0.cy, rx:Rx*1.15, ry:Ry*1.35, c:1, e:0, m:t0.m });
}
function randTile(){ return DISC.hot[rnd(DISC.hot.length)] || 0; }
/* a node writes to the blocks its own memory indices name, so the address on
   the card and the address struck into the drum are the same address */
function tileFor(num){
  const a = DISC.byNum && DISC.byNum.get(num);
  if(a && a.length) return a[rnd(a.length)];
  return randTile();
}

/* ---------- pointer ---------- */
let mx=-9999, my=-9999, has=false, sel=-1, selPrev=-1;
let cardX=0, cardY=0, cardTX=0, cardTY=0, cardSide=1, cardShown=false;
let cardW=252, cardH=110, cardMeasured=-1;
function pt(e){
  if(e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.glass,.side,header,footer')){
    has=false; mx=my=-9999; return;
  }

  mx = e.clientX;

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', pt, {passive:true});
document.addEventListener('pointerleave', ()=>{ has=false; mx=my=-9999; }, {passive:true});

/* =======================================================================
   RETRIEVAL SWEEP
   ===================================================================== */
const SR = { st:'idle', t:0, beams:[], endT:0, hops:[], drops:[], dumpT:0,
             vis:[], origin:null, cool:UI.firstQuery, scanA:0, arrived:0,
             fading:false, doneAt:-1, rets:[], retT:0, outT:0,
             /* every clock inside the query runs through this. It drops back to
                1 the moment the opening query has played out. */
             rate:UI.firstRate };
const AUTO = !REDUCED;
function live(id){ return N[id].sh === 1; }
function pickNb(id, pred, avoid){
  const c = NB[id].filter(b => live(b) && pred(b) && (!avoid || avoid.indexOf(b)<0));
  if(!c.length){ const d = NB[id].filter(b => live(b) && pred(b)); return d.length ? d[rnd(d.length)] : null; }
  return c[rnd(c.length)];
}
function crossPartner(id, want){
  const c = CROSSL.filter(l => l.a===id || l.b===id)
                  .map(l => l.a===id ? l.b : l.a)
                  .filter(o => N[o].side===want && live(o));
  return c.length ? c[rnd(c.length)] : null;
}
function buildPlan(){
  const beams = [];
  const labs   = shuf((KIND.label||[]).filter(live));
  const ents   = shuf([].concat(KIND.entity||[], KIND.person||[], KIND.know||[]).filter(live));
  const rights = shuf(N.filter(n=>n.side==='R' && n.sh).map(n=>n.id));

  const targets = [];
  for(let i=0;i<2 && i<labs.length;i++)   targets.push(labs[i]);
  for(let i=0;i<2 && i<ents.length;i++)   targets.push(ents[i]);
  for(let i=0;i<3 && i<rights.length;i++) targets.push(rights[i]);
  const land = [];
  shuf(targets).forEach((id,i)=>{
    const dur = 0.46 + Math.random()*0.30;
    const t0  = 0.02 + i*0.035;
    beams.push({ from:null, to:id, t0, dur, k:'entry', done:false });
    land.push({ id, end:t0+dur });
  });

  for(const e of land){
    const n = N[e.id];
    if(n.side==='L'){
      const isLab = n.k==='label';
      const step = pickNb(e.id, b => N[b].side==='L' && (N[b].k==='label') !== isLab);
      if(step!=null)
        beams.push({ from:e.id, to:step, t0:e.end+0.05,
                     dur:.28+Math.random()*.20, k:'walk', done:false });
      const over = crossPartner(e.id,'R') || (rights.length ? rights[rnd(rights.length)] : null);
      if(over!=null)
        beams.push({ from:e.id, to:over, t0:e.end+0.13,
                     dur:.40+Math.random()*.24, k:'cross', done:false });
    } else {
      let back = crossPartner(e.id,'L');
      if(back==null) back = pickNb(e.id, b => N[b].side==='L');
      if(back==null && labs.length) back = labs[rnd(labs.length)];
      if(back!=null)
        beams.push({ from:e.id, to:back, t0:e.end+0.09,
                     dur:.40+Math.random()*.24, k:'cross', done:false });
    }
  }
  return beams;
}
function startSearch(){
  if(SR.st!=='idle' || GROW.live) return;
  const beams = buildPlan();
  if(!beams.length) return;
  SR.beams = beams;
  SR.endT = beams.reduce((m,b)=>Math.max(m, b.t0+b.dur), 0);
  SR.t = 0; SR.dumpT = 0;
  SR.hops.length = 0; SR.drops.length = 0; SR.vis.length = 0; SR.arrived = 0;
  SR.rets.length = 0; SR.retT = 0; SR.outT = 0;
  SR.fading = false; SR.doneAt = -1;
  SR.st = 'scan';
}
function visit(id){
  N[id].se = 1;
  if(SR.vis.indexOf(id)<0) SR.vis.push(id);
  const nb = shuf(NB[id].filter(live)).slice(0, 3+rnd(3));
  for(const b of nb) SR.hops.push({a:id, b:b, u:0, dur:.28+Math.random()*.24});
}
function beamFn(b){
  const to = N[b.to], p1 = [to.x, to.y];
  const p0 = b.from==null ? SR.origin : [N[b.from].x, N[b.from].y];
  if(!p0) return null;
  let cx, cy;
  if(b.k==='cross' && b.from!=null){
    const c = ctl(N[b.from], to); cx = c[0]; cy = c[1];
  } else {
    const dx = p1[0]-p0[0], dy = p1[1]-p0[1];
    const bow = b.k==='entry' ? 0.10 : 0.17;
    cx = (p0[0]+p1[0])/2 - dy*bow; cy = (p0[1]+p1[1])/2 + dx*bow;
  }
  return u => { const iu = 1-u;
    return [iu*iu*p0[0]+2*iu*u*cx+u*u*p1[0], iu*iu*p0[1]+2*iu*u*cy+u*u*p1[1]]; };
}
function stepSearch(dt, tNow){
  // one dial drives the whole state machine, so the opening query can be
  // played fast without any of its stages drifting out of step
  dt *= SR.rate;
  if(SR.st==='idle'){
    SR.scanA = Math.max(0, SR.scanA - dt*0.9);
    if(AUTO && !GROW.live && (SR.cool -= dt) <= 0){ SR.cool = UI.queryGap + Math.random()*UI.queryJitter; startSearch(); }
  } else if(SR.st==='scan'){
    SR.t += dt/0.85; SR.scanA = Math.min(1, SR.scanA + dt*3);
    if(SR.t >= 1){
      SR.origin = [ORIGIN[0], ORIGIN[1]];
      SR.st = 'fan'; SR.t = 0;
    }
  } else if(SR.st==='fan'){
    SR.t += dt;
    SR.scanA = Math.max(0.16, SR.scanA - dt*0.5);
    for(const b of SR.beams){
      if(b.done) continue;
      if(SR.t >= b.t0 + b.dur){ b.done = true; visit(b.to); }
    }
    if(SR.t > SR.endT + 0.45){
      SR.st = 'dump'; SR.dumpT = 0;
      SR.drops = [];
      shuf(SR.vis.slice()).slice(0,16).forEach((id,i)=>{
        const mm = N[id].mem;
        const k = 1 + rnd(2);
        for(let q=0;q<k;q++){
          const dur = .52 + Math.random()*.42;
          const ti = (mm && mm.length) ? tileFor(mm[rnd(mm.length)]) : randTile();
          SR.drops.push({ id, ti, dur,
                          u: -(i*0.045 + q*0.09 + Math.random()*0.45)/dur, done:false });
        }
      });
    }
  } else if(SR.st==='dump'){
    SR.dumpT += dt;
    SR.scanA = Math.max(0, SR.scanA - dt*0.9);
    let alive = false;
    for(const d of SR.drops){
      d.u += dt/d.dur;
      if(d.u >= 1 && !d.done){ d.done = true; SR.arrived++; lightTile(d.ti, 1); }
      if(!d.done) alive = true;
    }
    if(!alive && SR.doneAt < 0) SR.doneAt = SR.dumpT;
    // everything is on the drum — now the drum answers back
    if(SR.doneAt >= 0 && SR.dumpT > SR.doneAt + 0.75){
      SR.st = 'ret'; SR.retT = 0; SR.rets = [];
      const src = shuf(SR.drops.slice()).slice(0, 22);
      src.forEach((d,i)=>{
        const dur = .44 + Math.random()*.26;
        SR.rets.push({ ti:d.ti, dur, u: -(i*0.030 + Math.random()*0.16)/dur, done:false });
      });
      if(!SR.rets.length) SR.rets.push({ ti:randTile(), dur:.5, u:0, done:false });
    }
  } else if(SR.st==='ret'){
    // the lit blocks fire the answer back up into the owner at the centre
    SR.retT += dt;
    SR.scanA = Math.max(0, SR.scanA - dt*0.9);
    let alive = false;
    for(const r of SR.rets){
      r.u += dt/r.dur;
      if(r.u >= 1 && !r.done){ r.done = true; }
      if(!r.done) alive = true;
    }
    if(!alive && SR.retT > 0.35){ SR.st = 'out'; SR.outT = 0; SR.fading = true; }
  } else if(SR.st==='out'){
    // and the answer leaves — one gold pulse off to the right. Query over.
    SR.outT += dt;
    SR.scanA = Math.max(0, SR.scanA - dt*0.9);
    if(SR.outT > 1.05){
      SR.st = 'idle';
      SR.rate = 1;            // the trailer is over; settle into the real tempo
      const span = onQuery();
      SR.cool = 0.9 + span + Math.random()*1.0;
    }
  }

  for(const h of SR.hops){
    if(h.u >= 1) continue;
    h.u += dt/h.dur;
    if(h.u >= 1){ N[h.b].hp = 1; if(Math.random()<.5 && SR.vis.indexOf(h.b)<0) SR.vis.push(h.b); }
  }
}

const TBUF = new Float32Array(128);
function trail(at, head, len, seg, w, core, halo, f){
  const STEP = len/seg;
  let n = 0;
  for(let i=seg; i>=0; i--){
    const u = head - i*STEP;
    if(u <= 0 || u >= 1) continue;
    const q = at(u);
    TBUF[n<<1] = q[0]; TBUF[(n<<1)+1] = q[1]; n++;
    if(n >= 63) break;
  }
  if(n < 2) return;
  const LWs = Math.max(.8,S);
  ctx.strokeStyle = halo(0.085*f);
  ctx.lineWidth = (w*3.0 + 1.2)*LWs;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(TBUF[0],TBUF[1]);
  for(let i=1;i<n;i++) ctx.lineTo(TBUF[i<<1], TBUF[(i<<1)+1]);
  ctx.stroke();
  for(let i=1;i<n;i++){
    const k = i/(n-1), e = k*k*(3-2*k);
    ctx.strokeStyle = core(0.66*e*f);
    ctx.lineWidth = (w*e + .5)*LWs;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(TBUF[(i-1)<<1], TBUF[((i-1)<<1)+1]);
    ctx.lineTo(TBUF[i<<1], TBUF[(i<<1)+1]);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}
const CORE_W = a => 'rgba(255,255,255,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
const HALO_B = a => 'rgba(150,200,255,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
const CORE_A = a => 'rgba(255,226,168,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
const HALO_A = a => 'rgba(255,170,60,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';

function drawSearch(t){
  if(SR.st==='idle' && SR.scanA<=0.01) return;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.lineJoin='round';

  if(SR.scanA > .01){
    const u  = SR.st==='scan' ? ease(SR.t) : 1;
    const y  = RULE[2], x0 = RULE[0], x1 = RULE[1];
    const hx = x0 + (x1-x0)*u;
    const tail = Math.max(60, (x1-x0)*0.34);
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(hx-tail, 0, hx, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(150,200,255,0)');
    g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(214,236,255,'+(0.85*SR.scanA).toFixed(3)+')');
    ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6*Math.max(.8,S);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(Math.max(x0,hx-tail), y); ctx.lineTo(hx, y); ctx.stroke();
    if(WHITEGLOW){
      const k = 26*Math.max(.7,S);
      ctx.globalAlpha = SR.scanA*(0.35+0.65*u);
      ctx.drawImage(WHITEGLOW, hx-k, y-k*0.45, k*2, k*0.9);
      const q = (52 + 34*u)*Math.max(.7,S);
      ctx.globalAlpha = SR.scanA*(0.20+0.80*u*u);
      ctx.drawImage(WHITEGLOW, ORIGIN[0]-q, ORIGIN[1]-q*0.62, q*2, q*1.24);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(0.95*SR.scanA*(0.3+0.7*u)).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ORIGIN[0], ORIGIN[1], (1.6+1.8*u)*Math.max(.8,S), 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
  }

  if(SR.st==='fan'){
    for(const b of SR.beams){
      const u = (SR.t - b.t0)/b.dur;
      if(u <= 0 || u > 1.30) continue;
      const at = beamFn(b); if(!at) continue;
      const lead = b.k==='entry' ? 1 : 0.86;
      trail(at, Math.min(1,u), b.k==='entry'?0.52:0.46,
            b.k==='entry'?12:10, b.k==='cross'?1.6:1.5, CORE_W, HALO_B, lead);
    }
  }

  for(const h of SR.hops){
    if(h.u <= 0 || h.u > 1.25) continue;
    const a = N[h.a], b = N[h.b];
    const at = u => [a.x+(b.x-a.x)*u, a.y+(b.y-a.y)*u];
    trail(at, Math.min(1,h.u), 0.5, 6, 1.15, CORE_W, HALO_B, 0.72);
  }

  if(SR.st==='dump'){
    for(const d of SR.drops){
      if(d.u <= 0 || d.u > 1) continue;
      const n = N[d.id], T = DISC.tiles[d.ti % DISC.tiles.length];
      if(!T) continue;
      const ax=n.x, ay=n.y, bx=T.x, by=T.y;
      const cx = ax + (bx-ax)*0.16, cy = ay + (by-ay)*0.80;
      const at = u => { const iu=1-u;
        return [iu*iu*ax+2*iu*u*cx+u*u*bx, iu*iu*ay+2*iu*u*cy+u*u*by]; };
      trail(at, d.u, 0.42, 11, 1.5, CORE_A, HALO_A, 1);
    }
  }

  /* the drum answering: gold light climbing back out of the lit blocks, up
     past the cortex, and gathering on the VoiceMem wordmark itself */
  if(SR.st==='ret'){
    const gx = ORIGIN[0], gy = ORIGIN[1];
    for(const r of SR.rets){
      if(r.u <= 0 || r.u > 1) continue;
      const T = DISC.tiles[r.ti % DISC.tiles.length];
      if(!T) continue;
      const ax=T.cx, ay=T.cy, bx=gx, by=gy;
      const cx = ax + (bx-ax)*0.78, cy = ay + (by-ay)*0.24;
      const at = u => { const iu=1-u;
        return [iu*iu*ax+2*iu*u*cx+u*u*bx, iu*iu*ay+2*iu*u*cy+u*u*by]; };
      trail(at, r.u, 0.44, 12, 1.7, CORE_A, HALO_A, 1);
    }
    if(BRASSGLOW){
      const done = SR.rets.filter(r=>r.done).length / Math.max(1, SR.rets.length);
      const k = (46 + 96*done)*Math.max(.7,S);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.28 + 0.60*done;
      ctx.drawImage(BRASSGLOW, gx-k, gy-k*0.66, k*2, k*1.32);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  /* the answer leaving — one gold pulse straight out of the wordmark, dead
     level, off the right edge of the window */
  if(SR.st==='out'){
    const ax = ORIGIN[0], ay = ORIGIN[1];
    const e = ease(Math.min(1, SR.outT/0.92));
    const bx = W+140, by = ay;
    const at = u => [ax+(bx-ax)*u, ay+(by-ay)*u];
    trail(at, e, 0.55, 20, 3.6, CORE_A, HALO_A, 1);
    for(let q=0;q<3;q++){
      const ph = SR.outT/0.9 - q*0.13;
      if(ph<=0 || ph>=1) continue;
      const rr = (10 + ph*150)*Math.max(.7,S);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,206,120,'+((1-ph)*(1-ph)*0.7).toFixed(3)+')';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(.8,(2.4-ph*1.9)*Math.max(.8,S));
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax, ay, rr, 0, 6.2832); ctx.stroke();
    }
    if(BRASSGLOW){
      const f = Math.max(0, 1-SR.outT/0.9);
      const k = (78+96*e)*Math.max(.7,S);
      ctx.globalAlpha = f;
      ctx.drawImage(BRASSGLOW, ax-k, ay-k*0.62, k*2, k*1.24);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
}
function ease(u){ u=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,u)); return u*u*(3-2*u); }

/* ---------- loop ---------- */
let t0 = performance.now(), tPrev = t0;
let AMB = 1;
function frame(now){
  const t = (now-t0)/1000;
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now-tPrev)/1000); tPrev = now;
  // page one is out of sight — stop burning frames on it
  if(pageFade < 0.02){ requestAnimationFrame(frame); return; }
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

  // presence — a node fades in once it exists, and only then
  for(const n of N){
    if(n.sh){ if(t >= n.dl) n.iv = Math.min(1, n.iv + dt*4.2); }
    else      n.iv = Math.max(0, n.iv - dt*2.6);
  }

  // the sprout — filaments reach out of what is already there, and a memory
  // lands on the end of each one
  if(GROW.live){
    GROW.t += dt;
    let busyG = false;
    for(const g of GROW.items){
      g.u = (GROW.t - g.t0)/g.dur;
      if(g.u >= 1 && !g.born){
        g.born = true;
        const n = N[g.id];
        n.sh = 1; n.dl = 0; n.iv = 0.25; n.se = 1; n.hp = 1;
      }
      if(g.u < 1.7) busyG = true;
    }
    if(!busyG){ GROW.live = false; GROW.items = []; }
  }

  // positions
  const amp = REDUCED ? 0 : 3.1*S;
  for(const n of N){
    n.x = n.sx + Math.sin(t*n.sp + n.ph)*amp*n.ax;
    n.y = n.sy + Math.cos(t*n.sp*0.83 + n.ph2)*amp*n.ay;
  }

  stepSearch(dt, t);

  // nearest node to cursor
  let best=-1, bd=1e9;
  if(has){
    for(const n of N){
      if(n.iv < 0.35) continue;
      let d;
      if(n.k==='label' && n.bw){
        const dx=Math.max(Math.abs(n.x-mx)-n.bw/2,0), dy=Math.max(Math.abs(n.y-my)-n.bh/2,0);
        d = Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      } else {
        d = Math.max(0, Math.hypot(n.x-mx, n.y-my) - n.r*2.0*S*0.85);
      }
      if(d<bd){ bd=d; best=n.id; }
    }
    if(bd > Math.max(24, 40*S)) best = -1;
  }
  sel = best;

  const fieldR = 150*S;
  stampV++;
  if(sel>=0){ const nb = NB[sel]; for(let i=0;i<nb.length;i++) LITSTAMP[nb[i]] = stampV; }
  const busy = SR.st!=='idle';
  for(const n of N){
    const tgtH = (n.id===sel) ? 1 : (LITSTAMP[n.id]===stampV ? 0.42 : 0);
    n.h += (tgtH-n.h) * (tgtH ? .22 : .10);
    let p = 0;
    if(has){
      const d = Math.hypot(n.x-mx, n.y-my);
      p = d<fieldR ? (1-d/fieldR) : 0;  p *= p;
    }
    n.p += (p-n.p)*.14;
    const tgtF = (!focus || n.k==='label' || GROUP[focus].indexOf(n.k)>=0) ? 1 : .16;
    n.f += (tgtF-n.f)*.12;
    if(n.se>0) n.se = Math.max(0, n.se - dt*(busy ? .16 : .85));
    if(n.hp>0) n.hp = Math.max(0, n.hp - dt*(busy ? .32 : 1.15));
  }

  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  const LW = Math.max(.72,S);
  HOT.length = 0;
  for(const g of LGROUPS){
    const st = g.st;
    ctx.strokeStyle = st[0]+Math.min(.95, st[1]*g.w).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.lineWidth = st[2]*LW;
    ctx.beginPath();
    let any = false;
    for(const l of g.list){
      const a=N[l.a], b=N[l.b];
      if(a.h+b.h+a.p+b.p+a.se+b.se+a.hp+b.hp > .006 || a.f<.995 || b.f<.995
         || a.iv<.995 || b.iv<.995){ HOT.push(l); continue; }
      ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);
      if(l.t==='cross'){ const c = ctl(a,b); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(c[0],c[1],b.x,b.y); }
      else ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);
      any = true;
    }
    if(any) ctx.stroke();
  }
  for(const l of HOT){
    const a=N[l.a], b=N[l.b];
    const st = LSTYLE[l.t] || LSTYLE.in;
    const lift = Math.max(a.h,b.h)*.38 + Math.max(a.p,b.p)*.14
               + Math.min(a.se+a.hp, b.se+b.hp)*.55;
    const al = (st[1]*(l.w||1) + lift) * Math.min(a.f,b.f) * Math.min(a.iv,b.iv);
    if(al<=0.006) continue;
    ctx.strokeStyle = st[0]+Math.min(.95,al).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.lineWidth = (st[2]*(1+lift*1.5))*LW;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);
    if(l.t==='cross'){ const c = ctl(a,b); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(c[0],c[1],b.x,b.y); }
    else ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  AMB += ((SR.st==='idle' ? 1 : 0) - AMB) * (SR.st==='idle' ? .035 : .12);

  if(!REDUCED && AMB > .02){
    PULSE.t += dt/PULSE.dur;
    if(PULSE.t > 1 + PULSE.trail) PULSE.t = -PULSE.gap/PULSE.dur;
    if(PULSE.t > -PULSE.trail){
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.lineJoin='round';
      for(const p of CROSS){
        const a=N[p.l.a], b=N[p.l.b], c=ctl(a,b);
        const f = Math.min(a.f,b.f)*Math.min(a.iv,b.iv);
        if(f < .05) continue;
        const at = u => { const iu=1-u;
          return [iu*iu*a.x + 2*iu*u*c[0] + u*u*b.x, iu*iu*a.y + 2*iu*u*c[1] + u*u*b.y]; };
        trail(at, PULSE.t, PULSE.trail, PULSE.seg, 1.5, CORE_W, HALO_B, f*0.84*AMB);
      }
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    }
  }

  /* the split burst — rings off the schema the new one was inferred from */
  if(SPLIT){
    SPLIT.u += dt/1.7;
    if(SPLIT.u >= 1) SPLIT = null;
    else {
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      for(let q=0;q<3;q++){
        const ph = SPLIT.u - q*0.15;
        if(ph<=0 || ph>=1) continue;
        const rr = (14 + ph*230)*Math.max(.7,S);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,214,130,'+((1-ph)*(1-ph)*0.6).toFixed(3)+')';
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(.8,(2.6-ph*2.1)*Math.max(.8,S));
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(SPLIT.x, SPLIT.y, rr, 0, 6.2832); ctx.stroke();
      }
      if(BRASSGLOW){
        const k = (70+150*SPLIT.u)*Math.max(.7,S);
        ctx.globalAlpha = (1-SPLIT.u)*(1-SPLIT.u)*0.9;
        ctx.drawImage(BRASSGLOW, SPLIT.x-k, SPLIT.y-k, k*2, k*2);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    }
  }
  /* the white filaments of the sprout, and the flash as each one lands */
  if(GROW.live){
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    ctx.lineCap='round';
    const LWg = Math.max(.8,S);
    for(const g of GROW.items){
      if(g.u <= 0) continue;
      const a = N[g.pa], b = N[g.id];
      const u = Math.min(1, g.u);
      const e = u*u*(3-2*u);
      const fade = g.u > 1 ? Math.max(0, 1-(g.u-1)/0.7) : 1;
      const hx = a.x + (b.x-a.x)*e, hy = a.y + (b.y-a.y)*e;
      // a bright halo under a hard white core, so the reach reads at a glance
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(170,215,255,'+(0.30*fade).toFixed(3)+')';
      ctx.lineWidth = 4.4*LWg*fade;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y); ctx.lineTo(hx,hy); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(0.95*fade).toFixed(3)+')';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.7*LWg*fade;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y); ctx.lineTo(hx,hy); ctx.stroke();
      if(WHITEGLOW){
        const k = (g.u < 1 ? 22 : 30*(1-Math.min(1,(g.u-1)/0.7)) + 6)*Math.max(.7,S);
        ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
        ctx.drawImage(WHITEGLOW, hx-k, hy-k, k*2, k*2);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
      if(g.born){
        const ph = Math.min(1, (g.u-1)/0.7);
        const rr = (3 + ph*42)*Math.max(.7,S);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+((1-ph)*(1-ph)*0.9).toFixed(3)+')';
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(.8,(2.2-ph*1.7)*LWg);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, rr, 0, 6.2832); ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  }

  /* glow */
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(const n of N){
    const g = GLOW[n.k]; if(!g) continue;
    const base = n.r*2.0*S;
    const k = (base*2.6) * (1 + n.h*1.15 + n.p*.24 + n.se*1.5 + n.hp*.6);
    const a = (0.36 + n.h*.75 + n.p*.30 + n.se*.95 + n.hp*.5) * n.f * n.iv;
    if(a <= 0.004) continue;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1,a);
    ctx.drawImage(g, n.x-k, n.y-k, k*2, k*2);
    if(n.se > .05 && WHITEGLOW){
      const w2 = base*3.4*(1+n.se);
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, n.se*.8)*n.f*n.iv;
      ctx.drawImage(WHITEGLOW, n.x-w2, n.y-w2, w2*2, w2*2);
    }
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';

  const SW2 = Math.max(.8,S);
  for(const kk in KIND){
    if(kk==='label' || kk==='user') continue;
    const list = KIND[kk];
    ctx.beginPath();
    let any = false;
    HOT.length = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      const n = N[list[i]];
      if(n.iv < 0.004) continue;
      if(n.h+n.p+n.se+n.hp > .004 || n.f<.995 || n.iv<.995){ HOT.push(n); continue; }
      path(n, n.r*2.0*S); any = true;
    }
    if(any){
      ctx.strokeStyle = hexa(PAL[kk], 0.72);
      ctx.fillStyle   = hexa(PAL[kk], 0.72*.16);
      ctx.lineWidth   = Math.max(.8, (kk==='entity'||kk==='know' ? 1.05 : 1.45)*SW2);
      ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for(const n of HOT) drawNode(n, SW2);
  }
  if(USER>=0) drawNode(N[USER], SW2);

  if(!REDUCED && USER>=0 && AMB > .02){
    const u = N[USER], base = u.r*2.0*S;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    for(let q=0;q<2;q++){
      const ph = ((t/3.4) + q*0.5) % 1;
      const rr = base*(1 + ph*3.2);
      const al = (1-ph)*(1-ph)*0.42*u.iv*AMB;
      if(al < .004) continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle = hexa(PAL.user, al);
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(.7, (1.5-ph)*Math.max(.8,S));
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(u.x, u.y, rr, 0, 6.2832); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  }

  /* cluster frames */
  const FS = Math.max(8.4, 11.4*S);
  ctx.font = FS.toFixed(1)+'px '+MONOF;
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  if('letterSpacing' in ctx) ctx.letterSpacing = (FS*.11).toFixed(2)+'px';
  for(const n of N){
    if(n.k!=='label' && n.k!=='user') continue;
    if(n.iv < 0.01) continue;
    const tw = ctx.measureText(n.w).width;
    const bw = tw + FS*1.6, bh = FS*1.95;
    const cy = n.k==='user' ? n.y + n.r*2.0*S + bh*.95 : n.y;
    if(n.k==='label'){ n.bw = bw; n.bh = bh; }
    const a = n.iv * (0.62 + n.h*.38 + n.se*.38);
    ctx.beginPath(); rrect(n.x-bw/2, cy-bh/2, bw, bh, 1.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(2,3,6,'+(0.78*n.iv).toFixed(3)+')'; ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(a*.13).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2.2, 3.4*Math.max(.85,S)); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+Math.min(1,(a*(n.k==='user'?.8:1))).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(.7, 1.05*Math.max(.85,S)*(1+n.se));
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(n.iv*(0.82+n.h*.18)).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.fillText(window.vmPage1GraphLabel ? window.vmPage1GraphLabel(n.w) : n.w, n.x + FS*.055, cy + FS*.06);
  }
  if('letterSpacing' in ctx) ctx.letterSpacing = '0px';

  for(const n of N){
    if(n.h<.02) continue;
    const r = (n.k==='label' ? Math.hypot(n.bw,n.bh)/2 + 8*Math.max(.7,S)
                             : n.r*2.0*S*(1+n.h*.55))
              + (9 + n.h*5)*Math.max(.7,S);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(n.x,n.y); ctx.rotate(t*.35);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(0.42*n.h).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(.7,S*.9);
    ctx.setLineDash([2.4*Math.max(.8,S), 5.6*Math.max(.8,S)]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,r,0,6.2832); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(0.6*n.h).toFixed(3)+')';
    const tick = 3.4*Math.max(.8,S);
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
      const ang = i*Math.PI/2 + Math.PI/4;
      const cx=Math.cos(ang), cy=Math.sin(ang);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx*(r-tick), cy*(r-tick));
      ctx.lineTo(cx*(r+tick), cy*(r+tick));
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  for(const n of N){
    if(n.se < .12) continue;
    const r = n.r*2.0*S*1.9 + 10*Math.max(.7,S);
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(n.x,n.y); ctx.rotate(-t*.6);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(0.5*n.se).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(.7,S*.9);
    ctx.setLineDash([3.2*Math.max(.8,S), 4.4*Math.max(.8,S)]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,r,0,6.2832); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]); ctx.restore();
  }

  for(const L2 of LEADS){
    if(Math.abs(L2.x1-L2.x0) < 16 || (L2.x1-L2.x0)*(L2.x0<W/2?1:-1) < 0) continue;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.62)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(L2.x0, L2.y0); ctx.lineTo(L2.x1, L2.y1); ctx.stroke();
  }

  drawSearch(t);
  drawDisc(dt);
  updateCard(t);

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

function ctl(a,b){
  const mx2=(a.x+b.x)/2, my2=(a.y+b.y)/2;
  const gx = CX + ((MY.L.x1+MY.R.x0)/2 - (MY.x0+MY.x1)/2)*K;
  const gy = Math.min(Math.max(my2, CY-0.12*IH), CY+0.17*IH);
  return [mx2*0.45+gx*0.55, my2*0.72+gy*0.28];
}

function path(n,r){
  const x=n.x, y=n.y;
  if(n.k==='emotion' || n.k==='prefer'){
    rrect(x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2, Math.min(r*.42, 3.2*S));
  } else if(n.k==='exper'){
    const h=r*1.12;
    ctx.moveTo(x, y-h); ctx.lineTo(x+r*1.02, y+h*.72); ctx.lineTo(x-r*1.02, y+h*.72); ctx.closePath();
  } else {
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y); ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,6.2832);
  }
}
function drawNode(n, SW2){
  if(n.iv < 0.004) return;
  const sc = (1 + n.h*.55 + n.p*.13 + n.se*.5 + n.hp*.22) * (0.35 + 0.65*n.iv);
  const r  = n.r*2.0*S*sc;
  const a  = (0.72 + n.h*.28) * n.f * n.iv;
  ctx.strokeStyle = n.se>.04 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,'+Math.min(1,a+n.se*.5).toFixed(3)+')'
                             : hexa(PAL[n.k], a);
  ctx.fillStyle   = hexa(PAL[n.k], a*.16 + n.se*.22*n.iv);
  ctx.lineWidth   = Math.max(.8, (n.k==='entity'||n.k==='know' ? 1.05 : 1.45)*SW2*(1+n.h*.35+n.se*.6));
  if(n.k==='user'){
    const col = PAL.user;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(n.x,n.y,r,0,6.2832);
    ctx.fillStyle = hexa(col,.20*n.iv); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(n.x,n.y,r*.63,0,6.2832);
    ctx.strokeStyle = hexa(col,.55*(0.72+n.h*.28)*n.iv); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(n.x,n.y,Math.max(1.6,r*.14),0,6.2832);
    ctx.fillStyle = hexa(col,.95*n.iv); ctx.fill();
    return;
  }
  ctx.beginPath(); path(n,r); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
}
function rrect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r); ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);     ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function updateCard(t){
  if(sel>=0){
    const n = N[sel];
    if(sel!==selPrev){
      selPrev = sel;
      cKd.textContent = window.vmPage1CardLabel ? window.vmPage1CardLabel(n)
                      : (n.k==='label' ? n.w : (n.k==='user' ? 'You · owner' : LABEL[n.k]));
      cId.textContent = '#'+String(1000+n.id*7%8999).padStart(4,'0');
      cSw.style.borderColor = PAL[n.k];
      cDsc.textContent = window.vmPage1CardDesc ? window.vmPage1CardDesc(n) : n.desc;
      cMix.innerHTML = '';
      const right = n.side === 'R';
      n.mem.forEach(v=>{
        const i = document.createElement('i');
        if(right) i.className = 'n';
        i.textContent = 'M：' + pad3(v);
        cMix.appendChild(i);
      });
      const s = SRC[n.k];
      cSrc.textContent = window.vmPage1CardSource ? window.vmPage1CardSource(n)
                       : (n.k==='label' ? ('cluster · '+n.cnt+' items')
                       : (s.endsWith('00:') ? s+String(10+n.id%49).padStart(2,'0') : s));
      cardMeasured = -1;
    }
    if(sel!==cardMeasured){ cardMeasured = sel; cardW = card.offsetWidth; cardH = card.offsetHeight; }
    const w = cardW, h = cardH;
    const gap = 34*Math.max(.8,S);
    cardSide = (n.x < CX) ? -1 : 1;
    let tx = n.x + (cardSide>0 ? gap : -gap-w);
    let ty = n.y - h/2;
    tx = Math.min(Math.max(tx, 10), Math.max(10, W-w-10));
    ty = Math.min(Math.max(ty, 10), Math.max(10, H-h-10));
    cardTX = tx; cardTY = ty;
    if(!cardShown){ cardX=tx; cardY=ty; cardShown=true; card.classList.add('on'); }
  } else if(cardShown){
    cardShown = false; card.classList.remove('on');
  }

  if(cardShown){
    cardX += (cardTX-cardX)*.22;
    cardY += (cardTY-cardY)*.22;
    card.style.transform = 'translate3d('+cardX.toFixed(1)+'px,'+cardY.toFixed(1)+'px,0)';
    const n = N[sel];
    const ax = cardSide>0 ? cardX : cardX+cardW;
    const ay = cardY + cardH/2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(0.5*n.h).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(.7,S*.85);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(n.x + Math.sign(ax-n.x)*(n.r*2.0*S+6), n.y);
    ctx.lineTo(ax - Math.sign(ax-n.x)*3, ay);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ax - Math.sign(ax-n.x)*3, ay, 1.6, 0, 6.2832);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(0.7*n.h).toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

/* =======================================================================
   ONE CONTINUOUS DOCUMENT
   Page one scrolls away like any other block; the veil over it darkens on
   the way out so the hand-off into page two is a dissolve to black.
   ===================================================================== */
const veilEl = document.getElementById('veil');
const cueEl  = document.getElementById('cue');
let pageFade = 1;
function onScroll(){
  const h = window.innerHeight || 1;
  const y = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0;
  const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, y/(h*0.78)));
  const o = 1 - k*k*(3-2*k);
  if(Math.abs(o-pageFade) < 0.0015) return;
  pageFade = o;
  if(veilEl) veilEl.style.opacity = (1-o).toFixed(3);
  if(cueEl)  cueEl.style.opacity  = Math.max(0, 1-k*3.2).toFixed(3);
  if(o < 0.05){ has = false; mx = my = -9999; }
}
window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true});

function measurePlate(img){
  try{
    const w = 320, h = Math.max(1, Math.round(320*img.naturalHeight/img.naturalWidth));
    const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;
    const g = c.getContext('2d', {willReadFrequently:true});
    g.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
    const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
    const col = new Float32Array(w), row = new Float32Array(h);
    for(let y=0;y<h;y++) for(let x=0;x<w;x++){
      const i=(y*w+x)*4, l=Math.max(d[i],d[i+1],d[i+2])*(d[i+3]/255);
      if(l>34){ col[x]++; row[y]++; }
    }
    const span = a => {
      let m=0; for(const v of a) m=Math.max(m,v);
      const th = Math.max(1, m*0.03); let i=0, j=a.length-1;
      while(i<a.length && a[i]<th) i++;
      while(j>i && a[j]<th) j--;
      return [i/a.length, (j+1)/a.length];
    };
    const [x0,x1] = span(col), [y0,y1] = span(row);
    if(x1-x0 < 0.2 || y1-y0 < 0.2) return null;
    const a = Math.round(x0*w), z = Math.round(x1*w);
    let c0 = Math.round(a+(z-a)*0.37), c1 = Math.round(a+(z-a)*0.63), mid = c0;
    for(let x=c0;x<c1;x++) if(col[x] < col[mid]) mid = x;
    const boxOf = (xa, xb) => {
      const cc = new Float32Array(xb-xa), rr = new Float32Array(h);
      for(let y=0;y<h;y++) for(let x=xa;x<xb;x++){
        const i=(y*w+x)*4, l=Math.max(d[i],d[i+1],d[i+2])*(d[i+3]/255);
        if(l>34){ cc[x-xa]++; rr[y]++; }
      }
      const [p,q] = span(cc), [u,v] = span(rr);
      return { x0:(xa+p*(xb-xa))/w, x1:(xa+q*(xb-xa))/w, y0:u, y1:v };
    };
    const Lb = boxOf(a, mid), Rb = boxOf(mid, z);
    if(Lb.x1-Lb.x0 < 0.08 || Rb.x1-Rb.x0 < 0.08) return null;
    return {x0,x1,y0,y1,mid:mid/w,L:Lb,R:Rb};
  }catch(e){ return null; }
}
function plateLoaded(){
  if(brain.naturalWidth) AR = brain.naturalWidth/brain.naturalHeight;
  /* Deliberately NOT calling measurePlate(): see the note on CFG.fit above.
     Skipping it also saves a full-plate getImageData() readback on first paint. */
  DET = null;
  resize(); brain.classList.add('in');
}
if(brain.complete && brain.naturalWidth) plateLoaded();
else brain.addEventListener('load', plateLoaded);
})();

  function applyPage1(l){
    const d=P[l]||P.en;
    setFirstText(document.getElementById('nav-lang'),d.language+' ');
    document.getElementById('nav-contact').textContent=d.contact;
    setFirstText(document.getElementById('nav-start'),d.start);
    const tag=document.querySelector('#shell .tag'); if(tag) tag.textContent=d.tag;
    const hl=document.querySelector('#shell .side.l h2'); if(hl) hl.innerHTML='<em>'+d.leftA+'</em> '+d.leftB;
    const hr=document.querySelector('#shell .side.r h2'); if(hr) hr.innerHTML='<em>'+d.rightA+'</em> '+d.rightB;
    const keys=document.querySelectorAll('#shell .side .key');
    const kt=[d.entity,d.people,d.knowledge,d.emotion,d.preference,d.personality];
    keys.forEach((el,i)=>setLastText(el,kt[i]||''));
    const hint=document.querySelector('#shell .hint'); if(hint) hint.textContent=d.hint;
    const facts=document.querySelectorAll('#shell .facts > span');
    const ft=[[d.accurate,d.accurateSub],[d.personal,d.personalSub],[d.realtime,d.realtimeSub],[d.efficient,d.efficientSub],[d.modular,d.modularSub]];
    facts.forEach((el,i)=>{ const p=ft[i]; if(!p)return; const t=el.querySelector('.t'); const e=el.querySelector('em'); setLastText(t,p[0]); if(e)e.textContent=p[1]; });
    setLastText(document.getElementById('btn-explore'),d.explore);
    setLastText(document.getElementById('btn-code'),d.code);
    setLastText(document.getElementById('btn-paper'),d.paper);
    setLastText(document.getElementById('btn-try'),tryLabel(d));
    setFirstText(document.getElementById('cue'),d.scroll);
    const demo=document.getElementById('demo-youtube'); if(demo) demo.title='VoiceMem '+(l==='en'?'demo':(l==='ja'?'デモ':l==='ko'?'데모':l==='zh-TW'?'示範':'演示'));
    const comments=CODE_COMMENTS[l]||CODE_COMMENTS.en;
    document.querySelectorAll('#page3 .comment').forEach((el,i)=>{ if(comments[i]) el.textContent=comments[i]; });
    const tabs=document.querySelector('#page3 .tabs'); if(tabs) tabs.setAttribute('aria-label', l==='en'?'VoiceMem examples':l==='zh-CN'?'VoiceMem 示例':l==='zh-TW'?'VoiceMem 範例':l==='ja'?'VoiceMem の例':'VoiceMem 예제');
    document.querySelectorAll('#page3 .copy').forEach(b=>{ const s=l==='zh-CN'?'复制代码':l==='zh-TW'?'複製程式碼':l==='ja'?'コードをコピー':l==='ko'?'코드 복사':'Copy code'; b.setAttribute('aria-label',s); b.title=s; });
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
  }

  /* demo 后端是自托管的（一台 Mac mini 走 Tailscale Funnel），它可能关着。
     开页面时探一下 /healthz：不通就把按钮置灰写「demo 暂时离线」，有人在用就
     写「前面几人」。探不通不影响页面其余部分，静默失败即可。 */
  const TRY_HEALTH='https://shuichengmac-mini.tailebef1c.ts.net/healthz';
  let tryState={up:null,queue:0};
  function tryLabel(d){
    if(tryState.up===false) return d.tryDown||d.tryit;
    if(tryState.up&&tryState.queue>0) return (d.tryBusy||d.tryit).replace('{0}',tryState.queue);
    return d.tryit;
  }
  async function probeTry(){
    const btn=document.getElementById('btn-try'); if(!btn) return;
    const ac=new AbortController(); const t=setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(),4000);
    try{
      const r=await fetch(TRY_HEALTH,{signal:ac.signal,cache:'no-store'});
      const j=await r.json();
      tryState={up:true,queue:(j.queue||0)+(j.busy?1:0)};
    }catch(e){ tryState={up:false,queue:0}; }
    finally{ clearTimeout(t); }
    btn.classList.toggle('down',tryState.up===false);
    applyPage1(lang());
  }
  probeTry();
  setInterval(probeTry,60000);

  window.addEventListener('voicemem-language-change',e=>applyPage1((e.detail&&e.detail.lang)||lang()));
  applyPage1(lang());
})();
</script>
