<script id="voicemem-scroll-motion">
/* =======================================================================
   Scroll-triggered motion.
   One IntersectionObserver drives three things:
     1. the four application plates — rule draws, words rise, photo dims
     2. the benchmarking bars      — grow from zero, left to right
     3. the benchmarking figures   — roll up to their printed value
   Everything is written so that a plate or a bar that is never scrolled
   past simply stays in its resting state; nothing here can throw.
   ======================================================================= */
(function(){
  var REDUCED = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var HAS_IO  = 'IntersectionObserver' in window;

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
     1. the bars. Their real widths live in the inline style attribute
     (an inline style beats a stylesheet, so they have to be zeroed in
     JS, not CSS). Park the target on the node and set the bar to 0.
     --------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var bars = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#benchmarking .rt i'));
  bars.forEach(function(b){
    var w = b.style.width || '0%';
    b.dataset.w = w;
    if(!REDUCED) b.style.width = '0%';
  });

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
     2. the figures. Pull the first number out of whatever the cell
     says — "61.68", "top-200", "K=5", "6,956", "17,120 ms" — and keep
     the text either side of it untouched while it rolls.
     --------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var NUM = /(-?[\d][\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)/;
  var nums = [].slice.call(
    document.querySelectorAll('#benchmarking .rv, #benchmarking .bn-hero-num strong')
  ).map(function(el){
    var raw = el.textContent.trim();
    var m = raw.match(NUM);
    if(!m) return null;
    var body   = m[1];
    var target = parseFloat(body.replace(/,/g,''));
    if(!isFinite(target)) return null;
    var dot = body.indexOf('.');
    return {
      el: el,
      target: target,
      dec: dot < 0 ? 0 : body.length - dot - 1,
      grouped: body.indexOf(',') >= 0,
      pre: raw.slice(0, m.index),
      post: raw.slice(m.index + body.length),
      done: false
    };
  }).filter(Boolean);

  function render(n, v){
    var t = v.toFixed(n.dec);
    if(n.grouped){
      var parts = t.split('.');
      parts[0] = parts[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
      t = parts.join('.');
    }
    n.el.textContent = n.pre + t + n.post;
  }
  if(!REDUCED) nums.forEach(function(n){ render(n, 0); });

  function rollNumbers(){
    if(REDUCED) return;
    var DUR = 1150, t0 = performance.now();
    (function step(now){
      var u = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / DUR);
      var e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - u, 3);           // same ease as the bars
      for(var i=0;i<nums.length;i++) render(nums[i], nums[i].target * e);
      if(u < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else nums.forEach(function(n){ render(n, n.target); });
    })(t0);
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
     3. the triggers
     --------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var benchFired = false;
  function fireBench(){
    if(benchFired) return; benchFired = true;
    var sec = document.getElementById('benchmarking');
    if(sec) sec.classList.add('is-in');
    // let the panels start lifting, then grow the bars out of them
    setTimeout(function(){
      bars.forEach(function(b){ b.style.width = b.dataset.w; });
      rollNumbers();
    }, REDUCED ? 0 : 180);
  }

  var cells = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#apps .ap-cell'));
  function fireCell(c){ c.classList.add('is-in'); }

  if(!HAS_IO || REDUCED){
    fireBench(); cells.forEach(fireCell);
    var cl = document.getElementById('closing-cta');
    if(cl) cl.classList.add('bg-in');
    return;
  }

  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(!e.isIntersecting) return;
      var el = e.target;
      if(el.id === 'benchmarking') fireBench();
      else if(el.classList.contains('ap-cell')) fireCell(el);
      else if(el.id === 'apps'){
        // safety net: content-visibility can delay per-cell layout, so once
        // the chapter itself is in view make sure every plate has resolved
        setTimeout(function(){ cells.forEach(fireCell); }, 900);
      }
      io.unobserve(el);
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.14, rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px' });

  var bench = document.getElementById('benchmarking');
  var apps  = document.getElementById('apps');
  if(bench) io.observe(bench);
  if(apps)  io.observe(apps);
  cells.forEach(function(c){ io.observe(c); });

  /* the closing nebula: requested a screen ahead of time, never before */
  var closing = document.getElementById('closing-cta');
  if(closing){
    var bgio = new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
      if(!es.some(function(e){ return e.isIntersecting; })) return;
      closing.classList.add('bg-in');
      bgio.disconnect();
    }, { rootMargin: '100% 0px' });
    bgio.observe(closing);
  }
})();
</script>

<script id="voicemem-apps-ribbon">
/* =======================================================================
   The Applications backdrop: a flat wireframe band given exactly one half
   twist between the left and right edges of the screen. Because the twist
   is half a turn, the band faces you square-on where it enters and leaves
   — full width — and turns edge-on in the middle, collapsing to a single
   line. Wide at both ends, pinched in the centre; a Mobius strip seen
   side on. Cross ribs travel left to right along it.

   It draws only while the chapter is on screen, and holds a single static
   frame when the visitor has asked for reduced motion.
   ======================================================================= */
(function(){
  var sec = document.getElementById('apps');
  var cv  = document.getElementById('apps-fx');
  if(!sec || !cv || !cv.getContext) return;
  var ctx = cv.getContext('2d', {alpha:true});
  var REDUCED = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ---- the only numbers worth touching ---- */
  var TUNE = {
    lines:   17,    // longitudinal lines drawn along the band
    ribs:    34,    // cross ribs travelling along it
    samples: 140,   // how finely the band is sampled left to right
    chunk:   6,     // samples per constant-shade segment
    flare:   0.52,  // how much wider the band gets towards both ends. The four
                    //   plates sit over the middle of the band, so the flares
                    //   have to open right past them to be seen at all.
    waist:   0.045, // half-height at the narrowest, as a share of section height
    drift:   0.038, // vertical sway of the band's centre line
    speed:   0.042, // how fast the ribs travel, screens per second
    ink:     1.85   // overall brightness of the wireframe
  };

  var W=0, H=0, DPR=1, t=0, prev=0, raf=0, live=false;

  /* On a phone the four plates run the full width of the screen, so the band
     is almost entirely hidden behind them and the slivers that do show read as
     noise rather than as a shape. Below this width it is not drawn at all,
     which also spares the battery. */
  var WIDE = matchMedia('(min-width: 901px)');

  function size(){
    var r = sec.getBoundingClientRect();
    DPR = Math.min(1.5, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    W = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.width));
    H = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.height));
    cv.width  = Math.round(W*DPR);
    cv.height = Math.round(H*DPR);
    ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  }

  /* u runs 0..1 across the screen, v runs -1..1 across the band */
  function centre(u){ return H*0.5 + H*TUNE.drift*Math.sin(u*Math.PI*1.2 + 0.55); }
  function halfH(u){
    var e = Math.abs(2*u - 1);                      // 0 mid-screen, 1 at the edges
    return H*(TUNE.waist + TUNE.flare*Math.pow(e, 1.5));
  }
  function point(u, v, out){
    var th = Math.PI*u;                             // ONE half turn, edge to edge
    var d  = v*Math.sin(th);                        // how near the eye this point is
    out[0] = u*W;
    out[1] = centre(u) + halfH(u)*v*Math.cos(th) - d*H*0.020;
    out[2] = d;
    return out;
  }

  function shade(d, weight, mul){
    var k = 0.5 + 0.5*d;                            // 0 far side .. 1 near side
    var a = (0.045 + 0.30*k*k) * TUNE.ink * mul;
    if(a <= 0.004) return false;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + (150 + (80*k|0)) + ',' +
                                (132 + (74*k|0)) + ',' +
                                (198 + (57*k|0)) + ',' + a.toFixed(3) + ')';
    ctx.lineWidth = weight*(0.55 + 0.75*k);
    return true;
  }

  var P = [0,0,0];

  function draw(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    var NX = TUNE.samples, CH = TUNE.chunk, i, j, k, u, v, dsum, n;

    /* the lines running the length of the band */
    for(i=0;i<TUNE.lines;i++){
      v = -1 + 2*i/(TUNE.lines-1);
      for(j=0;j<NX;j+=CH){
        ctx.beginPath(); dsum=0; n=0;
        for(k=0;k<=CH && j+k<=NX;k++){
          u = (j+k)/NX; point(u, v, P);
          if(k===0) ctx.moveTo(P[0],P[1]); else ctx.lineTo(P[0],P[1]);
          dsum += P[2]; n++;
        }
        if(n>1 && shade(dsum/n, 1, 1)) ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    /* the ribs, sliding left to right and fading at both ends */
    for(i=0;i<TUNE.ribs;i++){
      u = (i/TUNE.ribs + t*TUNE.speed) % 1;
      var fade = Math.min(1, Math.min(u, 1-u)/0.085);
      if(fade <= 0) continue;
      for(j=0;j<4;j++){
        ctx.beginPath(); dsum=0; n=0;
        for(k=0;k<=4;k++){
          v = -1 + 2*(j*4 + k)/16; if(v > 1) break;
          point(u, v, P);
          if(k===0) ctx.moveTo(P[0],P[1]); else ctx.lineTo(P[0],P[1]);
          dsum += P[2]; n++;
        }
        if(n>1 && shade(dsum/n, 1.15, fade)) ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  function frame(now){
    if(!live) return;
    var dt = prev ? Math.min(0.05, (now-prev)/1000) : 0;
    prev = now; t += dt;
    draw();
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  function start(){ if(live) return; live = true; prev = 0; raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  function stop(){ live = false; if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }

  function narrow(){ return !WIDE.matches; }
  function clear(){ ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H); }

  size();
  if(REDUCED){ if(!narrow()){ t = 0.35; draw(); } return; }

  function remeasure(){ size(); if(narrow()) clear(); else if(!live) draw(); }
  if('ResizeObserver' in window) new ResizeObserver(remeasure).observe(sec);
  window.addEventListener('resize', remeasure);

  var onScreen = false;
  function sync(){
    if(onScreen && !document.hidden && !narrow()) start();
    else { stop(); if(narrow()) clear(); }
  }
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
      for(var i=0;i<es.length;i++) onScreen = es[i].isIntersecting;
      sync();
    }, {rootMargin:'12% 0px'}).observe(sec);
  } else { onScreen = true; sync(); }

  if(WIDE.addEventListener) WIDE.addEventListener('change', sync);
  else if(WIDE.addListener) WIDE.addListener(sync);

  /* a backgrounded tab should not burn frames — and coming back should resume */
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', sync);
})();
</script>


</body></html>
